{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "high_atomic_number_and_chalcogenide",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "high_atomic_number",
          "conditions": {"mean_atomic_number_bin": "mean_z_high"},
          "weight": 0.8,
          "rationale": "High atomic number correlates with higher phonon peaks."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "chalcogenide_family",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "chalcogenide"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "Chalcogenides often exhibit high phonon peaks."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.25,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "hypothesis": "Materials with high atomic numbers and chalcogenide anions likely have higher phonon peaks."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "avoid_halide_and_balanced_elements",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "avoid_halide",
          "conditions": {"anion_family": "halide"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Halides negatively impact refractive index."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "balanced_elements",
          "conditions": {"max_element_fraction_bin": "balanced"},
          "weight": 0.4,
          "rationale": "Balanced element fractions can enhance phonon peaks."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.25,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "hypothesis": "Avoid halides and focus on balanced element fractions to potentially increase phonon peaks."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "high_atomic_number_and_chalcogenide",
  "lesson": "High atomic number and chalcogenide family materials show promise for maximizing phonon peaks.",
  "revision_summary": "Counter-hypothesis skill proposed to avoid halides and balance elements, but initial evidence supports high atomic number and chalcogenide combination."
}
